description: This script is a test suite for Git's notes merging feature, involving setting up commits, notes, worktrees, and performing various merge operations to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expectation with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command and expects it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file or output, verifying its presence.

methods.name: git rev-parse
methods.description: Resolves git revisions to their commit hashes.

methods.name: git notes add
methods.description: Adds or modifies notes on a commit.

methods.name: git config
methods.description: Sets or gets Git configuration variables.

methods.name: git update-ref
methods.description: Updates the value of a ref (branch or note ref).

methods.name: git symbolic-ref
methods.description: Reads or modifies symbolic references (like NOTES_MERGE_REF).

methods.name: git worktree add
methods.description: Creates a new working tree linked to the repository.

methods.name: git notes merge
methods.description: Merges notes from one ref into the current notes ref.

methods.name: git -C
methods.description: Runs Git commands in a specified directory.
